long_biography.plain_text:
Andrey Chernyakov trained at the Moscow Institute of Chemical Engineering and worked at a state research institute specialising in organoelement compounds. In 1991, he established NPO Kosmos from that institutional base, initially applying his inventions to practical construction work. His technical interests included protecting structures from harsh environments and strengthening foundations.

Chernyakov continued developing construction methods alongside running the business. He co-developed a patented retaining-wall design for tunnels and other underground works in weak, waterlogged soil. The design addressed a particular urban problem: excavating close to existing buildings without destabilising their foundations. His doctoral research examined jet grouting, a method of improving ground by injecting cement mixtures.
